zoe: Anyone got a quick fix for the sample worker? Edge runtime throws and TS types are garbage.
pat: What do you mean by garbage?
zoe: Editor shows `client.invoke(...)` as `any`. Runtime: 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' when deploying with Wrangler.
amir: Two separate things: resolution (ESM vs CJS) and typings (overloads/default generics). Which SDK import are you using?
zoe: `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` from the sample app.
pat: If bundler resolves the require path you will hit CJS in the worker. Check package.json "exports". You should have an explicit "import" entry (ESM) and ideally a `./worker` subpath.
amir: For TS, moduleResolution matters. Try `moduleResolution: "bundler"` or `moduleResolution: "node16"` if your toolchain targets node16 semantics. Some folks prefer node16 over bundler depending on their bundler.
zoe: My tsconfig had node. Switching to bundler fixed the runtime but types still inferred as any unless I annotate.
pat: That points at the d.ts. We had overlapping overloads where one fallback returned `unknown` which collapses inference. The short-term is to annotate calls like `await client.invoke<MyType>(...)`. Long-term we should simplify the public signature.
amir: Proposal: change exported signature to a single generic `invoke<T = JsonValue>(opts: InvokeOpts): Promise<T>` and remove the extra overloads. Default to JsonValue rather than unknown so inference is useful without annotation.
docbot: Suggestion: add a worker-specific d.ts in dist (dist/worker.d.ts) and add typesVersions in package.json for older TS. Example exports map: "exports": { "./": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }, "./worker": { "import": "./dist/esm/worker-entry.mjs", "types": "./dist/worker.d.ts" } }.
zoe: I added ./worker export locally and switched moduleResolution to bundler. Worker deploy now works, still annotated one call to get full type.
amir: That means the default generic is still too wide. I'll prepare a typings PR that: (1) replaces overloads with a single generic signature, (2) sets default generic to JsonValue, (3) adds a compat.d.ts for older TS quirks.
pat: Also add a quick troubleshooting blurb to the SDK README: minimal tsconfig for edge, recommend importing the worker subpath when running in edge, and note the annotate workaround until the patch ships.
ci-bot: CI: edge-worker job failed last night; created issue #957 and assigned @eng-runtime.
amir: I'll open PRs and link #957. Expected small breaking risk: some consumers relied on the old overloads; we'll add migration notes.
zoe: Thanks — sample workshop is unblocked now. I'll drop the tsconfig snippet in the repo and ping docs when the PRs land. :tada:
